visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a vibrant red and green floral vest over a white shirt, stands in front of a traditional Taiwanese temple background at dusk. She is seen pulling a long string of cheese from a pastry held in her hands. Red lanterns and ornate roof structures are visible in the background. (2) A man with short hair wearing a green t-shirt with a white graphic stands on a city street at night. He points upward towards a building sign. The street is lined with commercial buildings and parked motorbikes under artificial yellow light. (3) Close-up shots of a flat griddle where a cook uses a brush to apply sauce to a scallion pancake topped with fried eggs and fresh green basil. The food is then shown being folded and held in a plastic bag by the woman, who takes a large bite on the street. (4) The scene shifts to a specialized mold making duck-shaped cakes. The woman pulls a piece of the cake apart to reveal a stretchy, white cheese filling. The background shows a blurred temple facade with red lanterns, suggesting an outdoor market setting at night. (5) A tray of traditional Taiwanese rice cakes topped with braised pork and a bowl of clear soup with radish and pork ribs are shown. The woman sits in a brightly lit indoor restaurant, using a spoon to eat the soup and gesturing her approval with facial expressions. (6) Outside a medical clinic titled 'Wu Kuo-chen Clinic,' the man points at the sign. Inside, the woman stands at a wooden medical-style reception desk. A tablet displays a digital menu of high-end French-style pastries. A complex spherical green dessert is shown in detail.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, high-arousal female voice speaking rapidly in Mandarin, accompanied by a fast-tempo, upbeat pop-electronic background track with a strong 4/4 beat. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks the transition between the introductory clips. (2) The narrator's voice remains energetic as she describes the scallion pancake. Underneath the voice, the sizzling sound of frying oil on a griddle is clearly audible. The background music maintains a consistent volume, providing a rhythmic bed for the fast-paced speech delivery. (3) A distinct 'pop' and 'ding' sound effect occurs when text overlays appear on the screen. The female narrator's voice exhibits high pitch variability as she expresses excitement over a cheese pull. The background music swells slightly during the visual highlights of the food. (4) Sounds of a metal spoon clinking against a ceramic bowl are heard as the narrator describes the rice cake and soup. The vocal delivery becomes more descriptive and slightly lower in pitch but maintains a high speech rate without many pauses. (5) The acoustic atmosphere shifts briefly to a more mysterious tone with a slight echo as the man introduces the 'weird' clinic. This is followed by a 'ding' SFX and the return of the energetic pop music as they describe the fancy desserts found inside. (6) The video concludes with the female and male voices overlapping briefly, encouraging viewers to leave comments. The music fades out with a standard fade-out transition, ending on a final beat synchronized with the closing logo appearing on the screen.
